title: Complete anchored seat removal and close the license register

outcomes.statement: An authorized admin starts offboarding from either existing detail screen; the shared entrypoint executes removal via the shipped connector capability or checklist fallback, reaches deprovisioned, closes exactly the anchored register rows with ended_on/end_reason and refreshes capacity through the approved source-aware next-sync rule.
outcomes.demo: On person and request detail, remove API and checklist-backed active seats; each transitions offboarding->deprovisioned only after removal success/confirmation, closes the correct register row for each of the three reasons and exposes updated pool capacity at the next authoritative refresh. Failure keeps the register open; retry/concurrent confirmation cannot duplicate closure/audit; another company or wrong role is refused.

uncertainties.statement: How does standalone reallocated removal satisfy the existing successor invariant?
uncertainties.resolution: Requires canonical adjudication under CHG-074: BR-02 docs/specs/09b_business_rules.md:20-29 and the deferred license_assignment_reallocation_contiguous trigger in V20260725180000__core_schema_register_integrity.sql:24 require a contiguous same-person/account/type successor for a reallocated close. US-075 AC4 calls for removing seats for all three reasons with no successor input. Plain close fails COMMIT. Preserve the invariant unless Nous explicitly defines an exception; specify whether this is transfer with successor or a standalone close and which existing item owns successor creation. Inclusive date exclusion also matters. Estimated policy-change impact 45-90 minutes, contained in the broader estimate, not permission to modify committed migrations.

uncertainties.statement: Which delivered producer and persisted freshness contract makes capacity source-aware until the next authoritative refresh?
uncertainties.resolution: Requires canonical ownership/contract decision: packages/db/src/pool-snapshots.ts:59 derives occupancy directly from assignment dates, and its snapshot type has no source-refresh watermark. Closure becomes available next calendar day even without sync, violating DEC-SMP-031. apps/worker/src/jobs/deferred.ts:65 still defers memberSync to US-018; capacity-service.changeCapacity changes purchased quantity, while seat_freed only drives recovery. Existing seams alone cannot fulfill API and csv_import/manual AC3. Define bounded authoritative snapshot/freshness producer and consumer delivery without claiming US-055 ingestion UI or full memberSync already exists. Extra foundation estimate 90-150 minutes; full memberSync is excluded and needs canonical allocation if required.

uncertainties.statement: Is removal runtime/finalization already delivered by the provisioning prerequisites?
uncertainties.resolution: No: reuse connector deprovision capability/action-planner, observation/credential/composition and US-020 checklist framework. People repository uses an unregistered default dispatcher, worker automated-invite-delivery selects invite only, and checklist confirmation completes provisioning->active only. US-075 still needs removal dispatch/claim, failure/retry, atomic anchored register/action/request finalization and both screen wiring. Existing ended_on/end_reason update grants exist at core migration:193, so a missing closure grant is not established. Any freshness/integrity migration is anticipated within this child and included in scopes/signals, append-only with full verifier/parity/runtime proof.
